tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Must LP16-24100 25.6V 100Ah UPS Battery is a high-performance LiFePO4 (Lithium Iron Phosphate) battery designed for long-lasting backup power in homes, offices, telecom systems, and solar energy setups. Known for its outstanding durability, efficiency, and cycle life, this battery delivers stable power for modern UPS systems, ensuring maximum reliability during power outages in Bangladesh.


Whether you're running servers, networking equipment, CCTV systems, or renewable-energy installations, the Must LP16-24100 ensures superior power stability with enhanced safety and zero maintenance. It is the perfect solution for users looking for a dependable, long-life battery for professional and residential applications.

Key Features 


  • Long Cycle Life (4000+ Cycles): Enjoy years of reliable battery performance with advanced LiFePO4 cell technology.
  • High Energy Capacity – 2560Wh: Ensures extended backup time for UPS and solar power systems.
  • Smart BMS Protection: Built-in Battery Management System protects against over-charge, over-discharge, overload, and short circuits.
  • Fast Charging Technology: Charges quicker than VRLA/AGM batteries, providing faster backup readiness.
  • Lightweight & Maintenance-Free: No water refilling, no corrosion—simple installation and long-term durability.
  • Excellent Thermal & Chemical Stability: Safer and more reliable than traditional battery types.
  • Wide Application Compatibility: Suitable for UPS, solar hybrid inverters, telecom towers, home backup, and industrial systems.
  • Eco-Friendly Battery Solution: LiFePO4 technology ensures high energy efficiency with low environmental impact.
